articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 with Extended Reasoning and Native Multimodal Generation
articles.summary: OpenAI officially released GPT-5, featuring significantly improved long-horizon reasoning, native image and audio generation, and a 1M-token context window. Benchmarks show substantial gains in PhD-level science QA and multi-step coding tasks, with the model available across ChatGPT and the API. The release intensifies competition with Google's Gemini Ultra 2 and Anthropic's Claude 4 family.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics Models Enable Zero-Shot Dexterous Manipulation
articles.summary: DeepMind published results from its Gemini Robotics program showing that foundation models trained on simulation and video data can now perform zero-shot dexterous manipulation of novel objects in unstructured environments. The system combines a vision-language-action model with real-time compliance control, achieving human-comparable success rates on 87% of tested pick-and-place tasks. The work signals a meaningful step toward general-purpose robotic manipulation without task-specific fine-tuning.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 4 Opus with Autonomous Multi-Hour Task Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus, its most capable model, emphasizing reliable agentic behavior over extended sessions lasting multiple hours. The model can autonomously orchestrate tool use, browse the web, write and execute code, and self-correct across complex multi-step workflows. Anthropic highlighted new interpretability-driven safety guardrails that allow operators to audit the model's internal planning traces in near real-time.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Automotive Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Tesla confirmed that its Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robot has entered limited production deployment at two of its U.S. manufacturing facilities, performing repetitive material handling and quality inspection tasks alongside human workers. The company reports a 40% improvement in locomotion stability and fine motor control over the Gen 2 prototype. Industry analysts note this is among the first scaled deployments of a general-purpose humanoid in heavy manufacturing.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth with Mixture-of-Experts Architecture at 2T Parameters
articles.summary: Meta released the full weights of Llama 4 Behemoth, a 2-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model, under a permissive open license. The model activates roughly 200B parameters per forward pass and achieves performance competitive with proprietary frontier models on major benchmarks. The release includes optimized inference kernels for commodity GPU clusters, making near-frontier capability accessible to the broader research and startup ecosystem.

articles.title: ASML Reports Breakthrough in High-NA EUV Yield, Accelerating Sub-2nm Chip Production
articles.summary: ASML disclosed that its high-numerical-aperture EUV lithography systems have achieved commercially viable wafer yields for the first time, clearing a critical bottleneck for sub-2nm semiconductor manufacturing. Intel and TSMC are both expected to integrate the technology into volume production lines by early 2027. The advancement is expected to sustain Moore's Law-adjacent scaling and support the surging transistor density demands of AI accelerator chips.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: Neuralink announced FDA clearance for its N2 brain-computer interface, which features 4x the electrode count of the original N1 device and a fully wireless bidirectional data link. The approval covers expanded clinical trials for patients with spinal cord injuries and ALS, with the implant enabling cursor control and text generation at speeds approaching natural typing. The milestone advances the commercialization timeline for medical-grade neural interfaces.

articles.title: Figure AI and BMW Expand Humanoid Robot Deployment Across European Assembly Plants
articles.summary: Figure AI announced a major expansion of its partnership with BMW, deploying its Figure 02 humanoid robots across three additional European assembly plants for tasks including parts kitting, sub-assembly, and logistics. The robots leverage on-device vision-language models for instruction following and environment adaptation without reprogramming. The deal represents one of the largest commercial humanoid robotics contracts to date and validates the sector's rapid move from prototype to production.
